BiblicalUsage: Adadah was a town in the south of Judah, named once in the list of the tribe's cities, a border town counted among the twenty-nine cities of the southern district. As a place, Adadah is covered in the Biblical Places collection rather than in a biography.
TheologicalSignificance: There is no teaching in a town's name. The list keeps it because the land was divided by lot, town by town, and every town was counted.
